newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end higher led by gold rally.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end higher led by gold rally.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE

--------------------MARKET COMMENT---------------------------- * Toronto stocks ended higher on Thursday, led by a strong rally in gold shares * Precious metal gains partly offset by profit-taking in other sectors * 102 million shares traded
Toronto stocks ended higher on Thursday as heavyweight gold shares soared in an otherwise lackluster session, analysts said.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 20.86 points to finish at 6449.48 in brisk turnover of 102 million shares worth C$1.5 billion.
Advancing stocks easily outpaced declines 544 to 414, with 318 issues unchanged.
"We're getting a bit of play in the golds. Other than that there was a bit of profit-taking (in other groups)," said Montreal-based stock strategist Bill Ram.
The gold and precious metals group jumped 219 points, or 2.4 percent, as spot gold prices ended higher in New York.
Pipelines and retailing were among seven of 14 sub-groups that gained on Thursday. Profit taking depressed consumer products, conglomerates, transport and financial services.
"It wasn't much of a day. Just a bit of concentration in the golds," Ram said.
New York turned in a better performance with the Dow Jones Industrial Average adding 35 points.
--- HOT STOCKS ---
* Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce fell 0.25 to close at 33.60. CIBC reported a nine percent increase in second quarter net income on Thursday, but the numbers included some gains.
* Among gold stocks, Placer Dome Inc added 1.40 to 24.85, while Barrick Gold Corp improved 0.70 to 33.40.
* Airline operator Air Canada closed up 0.35 at 8.75 after earlier hitting a 52-week-high of 8.95.
* Diamond explorer Aber Resources Ltd jumped 1.20 to 20.50 after it released an update on its Diavik diamond property.
* Forestry player Repap Enterprises Inc topped the most-active list, adding 0.04 to 0.64 on 1.7 million shares.
